title: Patient Management - Create Patient with Valid Data
description: Verify that a new patient can be created successfully with all valid required data including CPF validation, medical history, and document uploads.

steps.description: Navigate to patient creation page
Fill patient form with valid name, CPF, contact info, medical history, and upload documents
Submit the patient form
Confirm patient creation success message appears
Verify new patient appears in patient list with correct details

title: Patient Management - Prevent Duplicate CPF Entry
description: Verify system prevents creation of a patient with a CPF that already exists in the database.

steps.description: Navigate to patient creation page
Enter a CPF that is already registered in the system
Attempt to submit the patient form
Check error message indicating duplicate CPF is shown
Verify the patient is not created or added to the list

title: Appointment Scheduling - Create Single Appointment Successfully
description: Verify that users can create a new appointment with valid therapist, patient, date, and time, ensuring no conflict exists.

steps.description: Navigate to appointment scheduling page
Select patient, therapist, date and time without conflicts
Submit the appointment creation form
Confirm appointment is listed in the weekly calendar
Verify notifications are queued for patient and therapist

title: Appointment Scheduling - Prevent Scheduling Conflicts
description: Verify system prevents scheduling appointment conflicts for patients and therapists and provides appropriate warnings.

steps.description: Attempt to schedule an appointment for a therapist or patient that already has an overlapping appointment
Check that system displays conflict warning message
Verify appointment is not saved

title: Appointment Scheduling - Create Recurring Appointments
description: Verify that recurring appointments can be created with correct recurrence pattern and notifications are sent accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to appointment scheduling
Select recurrence pattern (e.g., weekly) with multiple occurrences
Submit appointment creation form
Verify all occurrences appear on calendar without conflicts
Confirm notifications are scheduled for each appointment occurrence

title: Exercise Library - Filter and Search Exercises
description: Verify users can filter and search exercises by video presence, difficulty level, and groups.

steps.description: Navigate to exercise library page
Apply filter by video presence
Validate exercise list updates accordingly
Apply filter by difficulty level
Validate exercise list updates accordingly
Use search bar to search exercise by name
Verify displayed results match search criteria

title: Protocol Management - Create and Edit Treatment Protocol
description: Verify custom treatment protocols can be created and edited with exercises, intensities, and durations.

steps.description: Navigate to Protocol Management page
Create new protocol with name and description
Add exercises with specified intensities and durations
Save the protocol
Verify protocol is displayed in list with correct details
Edit protocol and update intensity/duration
Confirm changes are saved and reflected

title: Exercise Assignments - Assign Exercises and Track Patient Progress
description: Verify exercises and protocols can be assigned to patients and that progress tracking accurately reflects session updates.

steps.description: Navigate to Exercise Assignment page
Select patient and assign exercise or protocol
Submit assignment
Verify assignment appears in patient profile
Update exercise progress after patient session
Confirm progress data is saved and reflected in tracking dashboard

title: Progress Tracking - View Metrics and Session Data
description: Verify that progress tracking dashboards accurately display metrics and session data for patients.

steps.description: Navigate to Progress Tracking dashboard
Select patient to view progress
Validate metrics charts render with correct data
Verify individual sessions are listed with dates, exercises, and progress

title: Clinical Documentation (SOAP) - Auto-save and Version History
description: Verify that SOAP notes auto-save periodically and that the version history can be accessed and restored correctly.

steps.description: Open SOAP note form for a patient
Enter clinical documentation text
Wait for auto-save interval to pass
Confirm changes are saved without manual submission
Access version history for the SOAP note
Verify previous versions are listed with timestamps
Restore an earlier version
Ensure restored content replaces current note content

title: Body Map Pain Assessment - Interactive Point Marking
description: Verify that users can interact with the body map to mark pain points and save assessments.

steps.description: Open interactive body map on patient assessment page
Mark multiple pain points on different body areas
Save the body map assessment
Verify pain points persist after reload
Clear all points and save
Confirm body map is cleared

title: AI-Powered Features - Generate Clinical Reports and Suggestions
description: Verify AI integration generates accurate physiotherapeutic reports, treatment suggestions, and risk analysis with precision above 95%.

steps.description: Input clinical data and initiate AI report generation
Verify AI generates a clinical report with relevant content
Confirm suggested treatment protocols and risk analysis are provided
Validate report accuracy meets over 95% precision by comparing with expert data

title: Financial Management - Record Payment with PIX and Generate Reports
description: Verify that payments can be recorded using PIX integration and financial reports and analytics can be generated and exported.

steps.description: Navigate to financial dashboard
Record a payment using PIX option
Confirm payment is listed with correct details
Generate financial report filtered by date range
Validate report data accuracy
Export report to PDF and CSV
Verify exported files are correctly formatted and data is intact

title: Reports and Analytics - Export and Download Functionality
description: Verify comprehensive reports for financial, patient, and clinical data can be generated and exported in PDF and CSV maintaining data integrity.

steps.description: Navigate to reports page
Select report type and filter criteria
Generate report
Export report as PDF
Verify PDF file downloads and contents are accurate
Export report as CSV
Verify CSV file downloads and contents are accurate

title: Authentication and Authorization - Role-based Access Control
description: Verify that users with different roles (admin, therapist, patient, educator) have access only to permitted areas and features.

steps.description: Login as administrator and verify access to all management features
Confirm dashboard, user management, financial and inventory access
Login as therapist and attempt to access admin-only pages
Verify access is denied or redirected
Login as patient and verify access only to patient portal features
Confirm unauthorized pages are inaccessible

title: Patient Portal - View Assigned Exercises and Appointment Booking
description: Verify that patients can view their assigned exercises, schedule appointments, and communicate with clinic staff via the portal.

steps.description: Login as patient on patient portal
Verify assigned exercises and protocols are listed and accessible
Navigate to appointment booking section and create appointment
Confirm appointment creation success and notification sent
Send communication message to clinic staff
Verify message is received and acknowledged

title: WhatsApp Integration - Send Notifications and Appointment Reminders
description: Verify WhatsApp integration sends notifications and appointment reminders to patients and therapists accurately.

steps.description: Trigger notification to patient via system
Confirm message is received in WhatsApp
Schedule appointment for patient and verify reminder message is sent before appointment
Confirm reminder is received at the scheduled time

title: Inventory Management - Low Stock Alert and Stock Update
description: Verify that low stock alerts trigger appropriately and stock levels can be updated correctly by administrators.

steps.description: Reduce stock quantity of an item to below low stock threshold
Confirm low stock alert notification is generated
Update stock quantity from inventory management interface
Verify updated stock value is saved and reflected

title: Task Management (Kanban) - Create, Update, and Move Tasks
description: Verify that tasks can be created, updated, moved across columns in the Kanban board, and states are saved correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to Kanban task management page
Create a new task with title and description
Verify task appears in correct column
Edit task details
Confirm updates are saved
Drag task to a different column (e.g., from To Do to In Progress)
Verify task moves and state is saved after reload

title: Notification System - Automated Notifications and Logging
description: Verify that system generates automated notifications and logs each event for auditing and compliance purposes.

steps.description: Trigger an event that should generate a notification (e.g., appointment creation)
Confirm notification is displayed and sent to recipients
Check audit logs for the notification event
Verify logs contain correct event details and timestamps

title: Data Security - Encryption in Transit and at Rest
description: Validate that patient and clinical data is encrypted during transmission and while stored in compliance with LGPD standards.

steps.description: Perform data operations requiring transmission (e.g., login, patient update)
Verify network traffic is encrypted using HTTPS/TLS
Access database storage location
Confirm data at rest encryption is applied to sensitive data fields

title: Performance - Page Load Under 2 Seconds on 3G
description: Verify that critical pages like dashboard, patient list, and appointment calendar load within 2 seconds under a simulated 3G network condition.

steps.description: Simulate 3G network conditions in browser dev tools
Load dashboard page
Verify page load time is under 2 seconds
Load patient list page
Verify page load time is under 2 seconds
Load appointment calendar page
Verify page load time is under 2 seconds

title: Responsive UI - Layout Renders Correctly on Mobile, Tablet, Desktop
description: Verify UI components and pages render and function correctly across different device screen sizes and orientations.

steps.description: Open key pages on desktop viewport
Verify layout, menus, and controls render correctly and are usable
Resize viewport to tablet dimensions and reload pages
Confirm layout adjusts and remains functional
Resize viewport to mobile dimensions and reload pages
Verify navigation collapses appropriately and content is readable and usable

title: Automated Backups and Audit Logging for Compliance
description: Verify that system creates automated database backups periodically and audit logs maintain complete records for compliance and recovery.

steps.description: Trigger or wait for scheduled backup event
Confirm backup file is created and stored securely
Perform various system actions (create/update/delete patient, appointments)
Verify all actions are recorded in audit logs with user, timestamp, and details

title: Form Validation - Invalid Patient Data Submission
description: Verify that the patient creation form enforces validation rules using Zod and React Hook Form and disallows invalid data submission.

steps.description: Navigate to patient creation page
Enter invalid data such as malformed CPF, missing required fields, or invalid email
Attempt to submit form
Confirm validation error messages are displayed for each invalid field
Verify form submission is blocked until all data is valid
